front.title: 'You Can See Everything' opens to $15 million at the box office
front.tldr: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's Elizabeth Holmes documentary opened to $15 million, one of the strongest opening weekends ever for a documentary and another data point for A24's box-office pull.

front.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI's workforce
front.tldr: Most Character.AI staff who were offered jobs at Disney have accepted, according to a regulatory filing, though the deal remains a stalking-horse bid another company could still top.

front.title: Patriots beat Jets 26-19 to make it three straight wins
front.tldr: Drake Maye threw three touchdowns as New England beat the Jets 26-19 at Gillette Stadium, extending the Patriots' winning streak to three games after wins over the Bills and Raiders.

stories.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund
stories.tldr: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to a newly created public benefit fund, though it has not yet detailed how the fund's proceeds will be used.

stories.title: Simon Willison ships llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
stories.tldr: Willison patched his LLM plugin for querying Datasette databases after it broke when LLM switched its HTTP library to httpx2, a reminder of how small dependency changes ripple through a plugin ecosystem.

stories.title: Simon Willison updates his llm-echo debug plugin to version 0.5
stories.tldr: Willison revisited llm-echo, a debugging plugin that mimics a model's responses without calling one, while testing pull requests ahead of a new LLM release.

stories.title: Benchmark's partners on investing without the rush
stories.tldr: Benchmark's five remaining partners discussed staying disciplined and based in San Francisco even as the venture market around them has sped up and grown more frenzied.

stories.title: Inscryption is coming to mobile, five years after launch
stories.tldr: The acclaimed deck-building horror game Inscryption is heading to mobile, with its developer marking the five-year anniversary of the original release with a Twitch stream.

stories.title: A neat trick for inline-rendering widgets with document.currentScript
stories.tldr: Developer Lean Rada describes using the document.currentScript property to drop a tiny inline script element into a page without extra boilerplate, a small trick for embeddable widgets.

stories.title: Starlink's two $55 plans trade speed for data caps
stories.tldr: Starlink offers two different $55-a-month plans, Residential and Roam, that trade download speed against data allowance depending on how you use it.

stories.title: Apple's next iPhone, iPad and Mac could all land on November 6
stories.tldr: MacRumors reports Apple is likely to begin a run of Friday product releases on November 6, potentially including OLED MacBook Pro and iMac models with M6 chips and an OLED iPad mini 8.

stories.title: Apple reveals iPhone Duo's battery capacity: 4,883 mAh
stories.tldr: An EU energy label confirms the iPhone Duo has a 4,883 mAh battery, settling earlier leaks and giving a clearer picture of how Apple's folding phone compares with the rest of the iPhone line.

stories.title: Apple hires former Meta lawyer to lead global litigation
stories.tldr: Apple has hired Scott Tucker, previously of Meta, as its new vice president of global litigation, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

stories.title: Taika Waititi says his Star Wars film is on hold indefinitely
stories.tldr: Taika Waititi confirmed his Star Wars movie, in development since 2020, has been put on ice indefinitely while he promotes his new film, Klara and the Sun.

stories.title: Julianne Moore calls Jesse Eisenberg's 'The Debut' one of the best scripts she's read
stories.tldr: Jesse Eisenberg's musical comedy The Debut closed the London Film Festival on a high note, with star Julianne Moore calling the script one of the best she has ever read.

stories.title: 'Imperium', 'Concrete Land' and '9 Temples to Heaven' win BFI London Film Festival awards
stories.tldr: The BFI London Film Festival gave its main prizes to Imperium, Concrete Land and 9 Temples to Heaven, while Aman won the short-film competition and three other films received special mentions.

stories.title: Netflix reports box office grosses for the first time, as 'La Bola Negra' earns $277,500
stories.tldr: Netflix disclosed box-office numbers for one of its films for the first time ever, with Spanish drama La Bola Negra taking $277,500 from four theatres as its awards-season run begins.

stories.title: Celtics beat the 76ers in overtime to close the preseason
stories.tldr: Boston closed its preseason with an overtime win over the 76ers, a tense finish that had the CelticsBlog team on the edge of their seats despite it being only an exhibition game.

stories.title: Hugo González caps a growth-filled preseason for the Celtics
stories.tldr: Hugo González closed out a preseason of visible growth for the Celtics, built on his summer with Spain's national team at the FIBA World Cup qualifiers.

stories.title: Celtics convert Devin Carter to a two-way contract
stories.tldr: The Celtics converted Devin Carter's Exhibit 10 training-camp deal into a two-way contract after a single preseason appearance impressed the coaching staff.

stories.title: A.J. Brown struggles in his Patriots home debut
stories.tldr: A.J. Brown had a difficult first home game for the Patriots at Gillette Stadium, saying afterwards: 'There are no excuses. I'll be better.'

stories.title: Patriots lose starting tackle Morgan Moses to an ankle injury
stories.tldr: Morgan Moses was unable to finish Sunday's win over the Jets after suffering an ankle injury, and was later seen in a walking boot.

stories.title: Drake Maye says the Patriots' offensive line deserves treats from Ann Michael
stories.tldr: Drake Maye praised the Patriots' offensive line after Sunday's gutsy win over the Jets, joking that Ann Michael should keep bringing them baked treats.

stories.title: Verstappen hits back at former F1 drivers over 2026 rules criticism
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen pushed back on criticism of the 2026 regulations from former drivers, suggesting their complaints come from not understanding the new rules.

stories.title: Ferrari reveals its biggest F1 upgrade of the year, bound for the US Grand Prix
stories.tldr: Ferrari is preparing its largest upgrade package of the 2026 season for the United States Grand Prix, with just two months of the season left to run.

stories.title: The maths behind Mercedes' potential 2026 title double
stories.tldr: Mercedes is on course to become double F1 world champions in 2026 for the first time since the Covid-hit 2020 season, according to the numbers behind its resurgent form this year.

stories.title: Rafaela, Abreu and Durbin named Red Sox Gold Glove finalists
stories.tldr: Ceddanne Rafaela, Wilyer Abreu and Caleb Durbin are among this year's Gold Glove finalists, with all three considered strong contenders for the award.

read.why: A24's $15 million weekend is proof of brand power; this is the playbook 40-plus brands, from McDonald's to Airbnb, use to prove their marketing actually works.
read.title: How today’s top consumer brands measure marketing’s impact
read.subtitle: Lessons from how 40+ brands measure their marketing impact, including McDonald’s, H&M, TikTok, Amazon, Airbnb, and Uber

finally.title: Karimoku and ASICS turn crushed trainers into furniture
finally.tldr: Karimoku New Standard and ASICS have released furniture cushioned with upcycled foam from unused trainers, a small, satisfying piece of circular design.
